comment: The maker gave no name to any knob, jack or button on this module, so hovering one shows no tooltip at all. The panel prints impulse, angle, gravity, bounce, on off and shoot, and sig, cv and trig under the outputs. The trigger jack is not edge detected: the voltage is cast to a bool, so any held voltage restarts the flight on every sample.
